adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a new credential-sharing path via `refreshOAuthTokens()`, which returns a raw `fetch()` `Response` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). Some adapters (e.g., Google Calendar, Office365 Calendar, Zoom) pair this with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` to tolerate a minimal token payload, but Hubspot/Lark/Webex/Office365Video only wrap refresh with `refreshOAuthTokens` and do not parse/normalize the returned data. In particular, Hubspot now assigns `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` even though the sharing branch would return a `Response`, not a `HubspotToken`, which would break token refresh when credential sharing is enabled.
